init_tool.description: the tool that ran init: /agentive:init (Claude Code plugin) -> claude, $agentive-init (Codex plugin) -> codex. Written by init, kept by update; absent (a manifest written before 2026-10-29) counts as claude. It is the default of the CI AI review tool (review-config ci_tool overrides it, decisions.accepted[CITOOL]).

verbs.description: a verb is either a real slot (cmd, tier, evidence, proof) or pending (status pending, reason no_evidence): init found no evidence for it and writes no command (spec.init_apply.empty_dir). Pending verbs are skipped by the verb wrapper, the Stop hook (PENDING) and the CI outer-verbs job. update turns a pending verb into a real one only from evidence.

public_api.description: optional: files that form the public API (RV1 public API change detection; absent -> detection skipped with a reason)

capabilities.description: probes T1 and T3 only (N-D8 2026-10-27); T2 and T4 are documented facts

tools.description: tool versions only: {claude_code, codex}. No CLI list is recorded (an agent checks a CLI with command -v when it needs one; decided 2026-10-16)

max_blocks.description: hook-counted consecutive Stop blocks before CAP. If > 8, also set CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP >= max_blocks (official cap counts only blocks with no tool call in between)

read_limit_bytes.description: context gate: a Read without offset/limit, or an unbounded cat/nl/bat, of a file larger than this is denied (design judgment 64 KiB)

strategy.description: keep_existing_propose_diff (D10): an existing non-mergeable file or hook entry was kept and a diff proposed. keep_existing_value (JSONMERGE): a JSON key that agentive owns already had a different scalar value in the user's file; the existing value was kept.

proposal.description: path of the proposed diff file (keep_existing_propose_diff)

key.description: keep_existing_value: dotted key path inside the JSON file, e.g. env.CLAUDE_CODE_STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP or sandbox.enabled

existing.description: keep_existing_value: the value in the user's file (kept)

proposed.description: keep_existing_value: the value agentive would have written

generated.description: sha256 baseline of every whole generated file and every managed region that init generated and update rewrites (spec.init_apply.update, init_apply.managed_regions). Key = the same stable id a drift item uses: <path> for a whole file (kind file), <path>#<region> for a START/END region of a shared file such as AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, code_review.md or .gitignore (kind region). A path is either whole or shared: it never has both a <path> entry and a <path>#<region> entry (update checks this; JSON Schema cannot express it). A whole-file hash is that of the rendered content (current template merged with the user's override files in .agents/custom/). A region hash is that of the region body: the lines strictly between the markers minus the provenance line (a constant notice line), LF-normalized and trailing whitespace trimmed. No entry records a date or a commit (REGIONNOSHA, E2E-09): the same content is the same bytes, so an update with nothing to change writes nothing; the stale-line check reads the working tree and the history of each named path, not a stored sha. On /agentive:update an entry whose current sha256 equals its record is overwritten (regions: body replaced); one whose sha256 differs, or that has no record, is user-modified: preserved and reported in .agents/state/drift-report.json, and only the explicit --force option overwrites it. Content outside the markers is never read or written. /agentive:update --status reads this map and the files, writes nothing, and lists the modified and missing entries. REVIEW.md has an entry only while review.managed_code_review_copy is true. JSON files cannot hold markers and are always whole files. Override files are inputs and have no entry. There is no CI drift check. A JSON settings file that is merged by key (JSONMERGE) carries `owned` and its sha256 covers only the agentive-owned part.

framework_version.description: framework version whose template produced this content

overrides.description: override files under .agents/custom/ that were merged into this entry's content when it was rendered (informational: lets --status and drift reports say that a customization already lives in an override)

kind.description: file: the key is a path; region: the key is <path>#<region>

owned.description: JSON settings files merged by key only (.claude/settings.json, .codex/hooks.json; decisions.accepted[JSONMERGE]): the top-level keys agentive owns. sha256 is then the hash of the agentive-owned part (the agentive hook handlers by event), not of the whole file, so an edit to any other key is never drift.

sensor.description: deterministic command whose output lists the work (lint, static analysis, CI status, TODO grep)

janitor.description: default off: no kinds until a human adds one

security_checks.description: security tools the repo already configures (gitleaks, semgrep, codeql, trufflehog), found by init/update from their config files or workflows (SECPATHS L1). RV2 consumes their check results; agentive never copies their rules.

config.description: the file that showed the tool: its config file, or the workflow that runs it

rank.description: 1 code/lockfile, 2 CI/build config, 3 README, 4 ecosystem official default

files.description: literal file names; generator builds the FileChanged matcher from these

pinned.description: user-stated value; excluded from derive/re-derive and from evidence precedence

fail_count.description: grep -c -E pattern counted on the verb log for the NO-PROGRESS failure count (for example ^FAILED); absent -> 0/1

coverage_report.description: test verb only: path of the coverage report RV8 reads for the new-code coverage gate; absent -> coverage_unavailable (skipped with a reason)

file_args.description: lint verb only: false when the command cannot take file arguments appended by `.agents/bin/verb lint -- <file>` (a whole-project tool such as go vet or tsc). The PostToolUse lint hook then skips it and the Stop hook runs it once through verify. init and update write it from the lint command (true only for a tool known to take file paths, false for whole-project and unknown commands). Absent = true

exts.description: lint verb only: file extensions the PostToolUse lint hook lints, for example [".ts", ".tsx"]. init and update write the source extensions of the primary ecosystem. Absent = derived from the ecosystem the manifest's evidence files name; docs and data files are never derived

stack.description: stack the repo already names (for example in a README or planning doc)

source.description: file that names the stack; it becomes a TODO line in the AGENTS.md region, never a command

todo.description: present only when a repo document already states a stack (BMAD pattern); never holds a command
